# Tridha

> Tridha is a partner-led AI consulting team for companies doing ₹20Cr to ₹1000Cr a year. We come in at the leadership level, as your strategic AI partner, and stay through execution.

This file covers consulting.tridha.net, the page where a company books a free 30-minute AI strategy call with Tridha. Tridha has offices in Mumbai and New Delhi. The firm's own summary is at https://tridha.net/llms.txt.

How an engagement works:

- Assess: we map your operations end to end and find where the friction is, where the data lives, and where the biggest pain points sit, before proposing anything.
- Identify: not a generic roadmap, but the two or three interventions that change the trajectory of the business.
- Build: in your environment, staffed by the same partner who scoped the work. Production, not pilots.

Track record:

- Fleet Safety AI (logistics, computer vision): a computer-vision AI system deployed across the entire fleet of a national fleet logistics company. 54 days to a measurable drop in harsh-braking events. Live in production, not a pilot.
- Battery Manufacturing (clean tech, AI engineering): cell-lifecycle prediction and failure-detection AI for a unicorn battery manufacturer, where every new chemistry took ten months to validate. Testing time is down to 6 days from 10 months.

The partners:

- Technology Partner: principal AI architect behind Aadhaar, the world's largest biometric identity program. Founded and exited an AI company acquired by Tencent. Former operating partner at a Boston-based billion-dollar private equity fund.
- Business Partner: strategy and consulting experience from BCG, KPMG and Freyr Solutions.

The free 30-minute call is not a sales pitch. We listen, ask about your operations, and tell you honestly whether we see an opportunity. If there's a fit, we tell you what working together looks like.
